prior_summary: Diffuse absolute TCP targets in the observed rigid drawer frame so handle approach, pull, release and clearance translate/rotate with target_pose while retaining robot configuration and world reachability features.
applicable_conditions: Prefer when target_pose is reliable and the drawer fixture is displaced relative to demonstrations, from the normal closed/open-finger entry or a nominal demonstrated pull phase.
termination_guidance: Terminate or hand off only after drawer position is near open_stop_m, drawer velocity is near zero, fingers are open, TCP has cleared the drawer and the block remains undisturbed.
limitations: Drawer-relative departure does not independently follow a displaced tunnel block. Relative labels do not establish missed-handle recovery, collision safety or IK reachability under large displacement.
